question: The Satish Dhawan Space Centre is located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sriharikota**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC)**, also known as Sriharikota Range (SHAR), is located in **Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• SDSC serves as the **primary launch site** for the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• It is situated on a barrier island off the **Bay of Bengal**, ensuring safety for launches and minimizing risks to surrounding areas.
 
• This facility is named after **Dr. Satish Dhawan**, one of India’s eminent space scientists and former Chairman of ISRO.
